repos_data.description: Open source gateway bridging Meshtastic LoRa, Iridium satellite, cellular SMS, APRS and TAK over a Reticulum routing layer. Keeps people connected when the network is not. Runs on a   Raspberry Pi.
A high-accuracy, multilingual rule-based Sentence Boundary Detector (SBD) with a drop-in adapter for pysbd, delivering faster and more accurate sentence segmentation.
